name: team-orchestrator
description: Guided team setup and a native workspace for rosters, verified session connections, task assignment and outcome review. Existing classic Orca teams remain available separately.

projectWorkspaceModes.title: Saved project workspace choices
projectWorkspaceModes.description: Project-specific workspace choices, stored as JSON text and managed by Create team and Settings in this installation. Does not grant management permission or change defaults for other projects.

sharedStorePreview.title: Default shared workspace preview
sharedStorePreview.description: Fallback mode for projects without a saved workspace choice. Create team and Settings remember project choices separately. Management requires explicit conversation approval; classic teams are not migrated.

sharedStoreNode.title: Shared store Node command
sharedStoreNode.description: Node 22.13 or newer executable for the opt-in shared store adapter. Invoked directly with structured stdin.

orcaCommand.title: Orca command
orcaCommand.description: Orca's command-line tool: orca.exe on Windows, orca on macOS and Linux, or a full path. Empty: detected and filled in at the next start. A command that does not start is refused.
